policy: role=ood_negative. Real (non-synthetic) rights-cleared footage that contains NO pickleball stroke by a target athlete. These clips exist ONLY to measure and test the pre-analysis OOD gate's no-confident-analysis behavior. They are excluded from datasets/corpus, from all splits, from training, and from every positive-label pipeline. Never annotate strokes, contacts, or ownership on these clips.
conventions: Provenance and rights fields follow datasets/pickleball/registry.json freshCandidates (wave-c/c16) conventions: per-item verbatim license quote, license verification method, provenance assessment with residual caveats recorded in restrictions, sha256 of the committed file, and a quarantinedUnknownRights section for items that were considered but NOT downloaded.

'empty pickleball court' returned no CC empty-pickleball-court footage; the accepted empty-court clip is a tennis court (recorded honestly as such).
1 accepted (CC BY 3.0 rally crowd); other hits were CC BY-SA (share-alike, avoided for derivative redistribution simplicity) or historical newsreels better represented by the Prelinger items.
